searchText: HI. We've updated PR clarifying gas cost for bls MSM https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9245 According to yesterdays ACDs' decision. For those that wanted to give feedback on the bandwidth requirements for validators, it is here: <https://hackmd.io/@kevaundray/S1AjGt241x> It is split into two sections: - The need for inclusion lists and how it affects our reliance on local block building for censorship resistance - The bandwidth suggestions plus citations on fibre optic development, and median/average bandwidth speeds in certain countries and globally As agreed on yesterday's call, I created <#1329867986814767136> to have a long-lived place for these discussions 🙂 And here's the recap of yesterday's call: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/all-core-devs-execution-acde-203-january-16-2025/22346/4?u=timbeiko
